description: This file defines a Moose role 'Coocook::Helpers' that provides various helper methods for Catalyst controllers, including URI manipulation, capability checks, redirection, and session messaging. It is used to add common controller functionalities within the Coocook project.

classes.name: Coocook::Helpers
classes.description: A Moose role providing helper methods for Catalyst controllers, facilitating URI handling, capability checks, redirection, and session messaging.

methods.name: current_uri_local_part
methods.description: Returns the URI for the current request with only the app-local part, suitable for passing to uri_for_local_part.

methods.name: uri_for_local_part
methods.description: Constructs a URI string by appending a local part to the request's base URI.

methods.name: uri_for_action_if_permitted
methods.description: Generates a URI for a given action if the current user has the required capabilities; returns undef otherwise.

methods.name: has_capability
methods.description: Checks if the current user has a specific capability, optionally using provided input data.

methods.name: require_capability
methods.description: Ensures the user has a specific capability; redirects or detaches if not authorized.

methods.name: messages
methods.description: Returns the session's message object for adding or retrieving messages.

methods.name: project_uri
methods.description: Constructs a URI for a project-specific action, including project ID and URL name.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Returns the current project object from the stash.

methods.name: redirect_canonical_case
methods.description: Redirects to a URL with a path argument corrected for case sensitivity if needed.

methods.name: redirect_detach
methods.description: Performs an HTTP redirect and detaches from the Catalyst request flow.

methods.name: redirect_uri_for_action
methods.description: Builds a URI for an action, adding a redirect parameter to the current URI.

methods.name: user_registration_enabled
methods.description: Determines if user registration is enabled based on configuration and existing users.
